summary: Dual-Stack Lite gives customers with only an IPv6 prefix both IPv4 and IPv6 connectivity, but the B4 element needs the address of the AFTR tunnel endpoint. This RFC defines RADIUS extensions so that information can be stored in AAA profiles and delivered to the customer equipment.

eli5.summary: Some homes only have the new kind of internet address but still want to visit old sites. This lets the provider's records tell the home router where to find the helper that makes that work.

questions: how does b4 learn the aftr
